title: Transition maps for powers times a module
statement: Let X be any scheme, J an ideal sheaf on X, and F any O_X-module. Use the powers and image products of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], with J^0 = O_X. There is a family i_(k,n): J^k F -> J^n F for all n <= k, whose composite with the image inclusion J^n F -> F equals the image inclusion J^k F -> F.

source.place: Lemma 02OA, inverse-system setup before proof of (1); independently read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OA

proof.text: Use the recursive powers and their image inclusions from the construction of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], not its still-open stalk theorem. The successor inclusion J^(k+1) -> J^k is J -> O_X at k=0 and J J^k -> J^k otherwise. Compose by induction, with identity when k=n.

Tensor each inclusion J^k -> J^n over O_X with F. Apply Mathlib image.map to the square of multiplication maps with identity right edge; image.map_ι gives the asserted factorization. Choose these already-proved maps for the existential family.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 02OA, inverse-system setup before proof of (1)

lean.statement:
theorem cohomology_powers_ideal_transition_maps
    {X : Scheme.{v}} (J : X.IdealSheafData) (F : X.Modules) :
    ∃ i : ∀ (k n : ℕ), n ≤ k →
        (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι k).2 F ⟶
          Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι n).2 F),
      (∀ (k n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ k),
        i k n h ≫ Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι n).2 F =
          Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι k).2 F)
